symptom: `alter microflow … replace body of loop … with begin declare $N Integer = 0; $N = count($List); end;` passed check and exec (Altered microflow); mx check reported CE0111 Duplicate variable name. The same body in create microflow is MDL063.
cause: ValidateAlterFlow ran only the annotation and template rules over a fragment; exec's clash checks (checkBodyUnclashed, checkDeclaredUnclashed) compare a fragment's outputs with the STORED flow's, never with each other.
insight: **A rule that needs nothing outside the fragment belongs on the fragment.** The flat namespace makes a duplicate inside one fragment CE0111 regardless of the stored flow; only the exemptions (void calls, String contains/find) need types a fragment lacks, so in fragment mode those statements are left out rather than guessed — a missed duplicate costs what it did before, a false one refuses a valid script.
